description: Everything for a new post like one that did well, except the new photo or video: its format, caption to start from, the accounts it went to, and its length. media_id is the original's file when it is still in the library (start the new post from it), else needs_clip is true and the person picks the clip. Use an id from insights_get posts (or a post_id). Make the post with post_create; the composer's next free posting time is the best time.

id.description: A post from insights_get posts, or an app post_id

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_like_this
title: Another post like this one
